name: Art Projector
summary:
Art Projector turns your room into your personal gallery.

Pick any image from your device and place it on your real walls in mixed reality. Decorate your home, office, or studio with your favorite art and photos - no frames, no nails needed.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Allow access to your photos and environment.
2. Choose an image from your device.
3. Point at any wall to place, move, and view your art in real size.

FEATURES:
- Real-scale image display on walls and surfaces
- Environment-aware placement using spat
